note: What a server sends to set what sits in one of a unit's item slots. It answers no request: a client clears the slot named and puts what follows in its place whether or not anything asked for it, so a server sends it to units nobody is buying for. The header names the unit this is about.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: The slot it went to, 0 to 37. A client rejects the message from 38 up.

fields.name: item
fields.note: Which item, by the number the client knows it as.

fields.name: inSlot
fields.note: How many of it are in that slot now. Zero places nothing.

fields.name: flag
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded. Where it is not zero and the slot holds an item, a client refreshes the slot and sends RemoveItem for it with sell clear. A server sends zero.

revisions.note: There is no charges field: a client takes an item's charges from the item's own data.

fields.name: activate
fields.note: Nonzero readies the item's own spell, in the slot four past the item's, and has the client answer with RemoveItem for it.
